block.guhs.olifantenloopband.lore: Run, Dikkie, run! (He is not too chonky. Just a little too VAH.)
block.guhs.fotolijstje_slanke_olifant.lo: Dikkie, after his diet. He fits through his gate again!
block.guhs.geheimpjes_trofee.lore: Found all eight secrets of Safaripark Vadse Bergen. Sniffer!
block.guhs.gouden_dierenbeeld.lore: For whoever photographed every animal in the safari park. Safari King!
item.guhs.gouden_safaricamera.lore: All 46 animals photographed. Your photos get golden frames. Vahoeg!
item.guhs.bordbon_gouden_dikdik.lore: Trade this voucher at the gift shop for the enclosure sign of the Golden Dik-dik.
gui.guhs.kleding.prijs.hint.vind_de_verm: Find the disguised guh in the safari park (three times!)
gui.guhs.titels.hint.speurneus: Find all the secrets in Safaripark Vadse Bergen.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.beverbaas: Have your beavers build five dams.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.safarikoning: Photograph every animal in Safaripark Vadse Bergen.
gui.guhs.safari.geheimpje.alle: All secrets found! You are a real Sniffer, chonk!
gui.guhs.safari.geheimpje.savanne: a hidden chest in the tall grass
gui.guhs.safari.geheimpje.regenwoud: the old pot in the temple ruin
gui.guhs.safari.geheimpje.bamboe: the old teapot behind the pagoda
gui.guhs.safari.geheimpje.ijskust: the barrel in the hold of the shipwreck
gui.guhs.safari.geheimpje.oertijd: the fossil in the ice cave
gui.guhs.safari.geheimpje.europa: the old ranger chest in the hollow oak
gui.guhs.safari.dexvol: Every animal in Safaripark Vadse Bergen is in your photos! You are the Safari King. VAHOEG!
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.ranger: A guh sneaked into the park, dressed up as a zebra! He thinks nobody notices. Can you find him? He's probably hanging around the zebras on the savanna.
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.ranger_bezig: Found that dressed-up guh yet? He keeps hiding with different animals.
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.ranger_klaar: Stripey lives with you now? Good. Take good care of him, chonk!
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.1: Chonk! I really am a zebra. Just look at my stripes! ...Okay, you got me. But you'll never catch me! *runs off to the bamboo*
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.2: I am a giant panda. I eat bamboo. Nom nom. ...Huh, you again?! *waddles off to the ice*
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.3: Penguins sure are cold here. Brrr. ...Okay okay, you win. Can I come home with you? I still have my zebra suit!
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.klaar: Stripey is your guh now! He's wearing his homemade zebra suit. +%s Safari coins
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.niet_nu: Psst! I'm just a %s, really. Nothing to see here. Chonk.
gui.guhs.safari.olifant.start: Pfff... Visitors secretly fed me snacks, and now I don't fit through my gate anymore. You can't be too chonky, you know... but I am a little too VAH. Will you help me with a diet? I'd like an apple, a carrot and a slice of melon.
gui.guhs.safari.olifant.loopband: That was nice and healthy! Now a little run on the elephant treadmill next to my stable. Click the treadmill a few times to cheer me on!
gui.guhs.safari.olifant.even: Dikkie is catching his breath. Wait just a moment...
gui.guhs.safari.olifant.klaar: Dikkie fits through his gate again! He is SO happy. +%s Safari coins
gui.guhs.safari.olifant.na: Look how slim I am! Well... a little. Thank you!
commands.guhs.safari.quests: %s · Too vah elephant: %s · Secrets: %s/%s · Beaver dams: %s
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_eerste_foto.des: Take your first photo of an animal in Safaripark Vadse Bergen. It goes straight into your Safari Dex.
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_drie_sterren.de: Take a three-star photo: close up, nicely centred, and preferably while the animal does something funny (sleeping, eating, playing...).
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_dex_10.title: Ten animals
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_dex_25.title: Twenty-five animals
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_dex_25.desc: Photograph twenty-five different animals. You're half a ranger already!
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_zone_vol.title: A whole zone
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_zone_vol.desc: Photograph all the animals of one zone. Then pick up your zone badge from the expert guh in the expert pavilion.
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_spoorzoeker.des: Some animals hide really well. Follow the paw prints (they light up through a spyglass) and photograph a hider, like the okapi, the badger or the beaver.
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_dex_vol.title: Safari King
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_dex_vol.desc: Photograph every animal in the park: all 46! You get the golden safari camera, the golden animal statue and the voucher for the Golden Dik-dik's enclosure sign.
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_geheimpje.title: Psst, a secret
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_geheimpje.desc: A secret is hidden in every zone of the park. Find one!
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_geheimpjes_alle: Find all eight secrets. Then you get the secrets trophy and the title Sniffer.
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_vermomde_guh.de: According to the head ranger, a guh in a homemade zebra suit is walking around the park. Find him, three times! Afterwards he comes home with you.
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_vahe_olifant.de: Dikkie the elephant no longer fits through his gate. Help him with a healthy diet and a run on the elephant treadmill.
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_aaihoek.title: Petting time!
ftb.guhs_safari.q.safari_aaihoek.desc: Do a chore in the petting corner of the entrance village: feeding, brushing or walking the alpaca.
ftb.guhs_safari.title: &6On Safari!
ftb.guhs_safari.sub: Safaripark Vadse Bergen: spotting, photographing and sniffing out secrets
ftb.guhs_safari.q.intro_guhs_safari.desc:
This chapter comes after &dWelcome to the Guhmension!&r in &dThe Guhmension&r.

Somewhere in the Guhmension stands a safari bus station. Hop on the &6Guh safari bus&r and it takes you to &6Safaripark Vadse Bergen&r: a big park with 46 sweet animals in eight zones.

Spot them, photograph them for your &dSafari Dex&r, find the secrets and help the rangers. Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it before. The headings show what logically comes next. Tick this off and get chonking!
gui.guhs.safari.bordbon.ingewisseld: Board voucher redeemed: the Golden dikdik's habitat sign! Sparkle sparkle, njeg.
gui.guhs.safari.vermomd.ranger_2: He keeps hiding with different animals, so keep your eyes open. The top right of your screen shows where to look. Good luck, sniffer!
gui.guhs.safari.tracker.waar.zebra: with the zebras on the savanna
gui.guhs.safari.tracker.waar.reuzenpanda: with the giant pandas in the bamboo
gui.guhs.safari.tracker.waar.pinguin: with the penguins on the Ice Coast
gui.guhs.safari.tracker.start.vermomd: Not started yet. Talk to the head ranger in the entrance village.
gui.guhs.safari.tracker.start.olifant: Not started yet. Pay Dikkie a visit in his stable on the savanna.
gui.guhs.safari.dex.quests.uitleg: What you are doing now also shows in the top right of your screen while you are in the park.
